harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured /tmp (new tmpfs mount) and /dev/shm on node1 with noexec,nosuid,nodev via persistent /etc/fstab entries, verified functionally (exec attempts denied) both before and after a full node restart, and confirmed persistence via a changed boot_id.
actions_performed: Captured baseline: /tmp was part of root fs (no separate mount), /dev/shm had nosuid,nodev but not noexec; recorded fstab and boot_id
Backed up /etc/fstab, added a tmpfs /tmp entry with defaults,nosuid,nodev,noexec, and updated the /dev/shm entry to defaults,nosuid,nodev,noexec
Ran systemctl daemon-reload, mounted /tmp fresh per fstab, remounted /dev/shm with new options
Verified via findmnt that both /tmp and /dev/shm show nosuid,nodev,noexec
Functionally verified noexec by creating and chmod +x'ing scripts in /tmp and /dev/shm and confirming execution returns 'Permission denied' (rc=126)
Captured pre-restart boot_id baseline, issued a native reboot (shutdown -r now backgrounded so ack returned before disconnect)
Confirmed connection dropped, then polled until node1 was reachable again
Verified boot_id changed post-restart, confirming an actual reboot occurred
Re-verified /tmp and /dev/shm mount options, fstab persistence, and functional noexec behavior after restart

evidence.requirement: Baseline capture of mounts and boot identity before any changes
evidence.summary: Showed /tmp not separately mounted, /dev/shm lacking noexec, current fstab, and initial boot_id dfdea52d-a1af-4d7b-803a-15f40ee9dd4e

evidence.requirement: /tmp and /dev/shm configured with noexec,nosuid,nodev and persisted in fstab
evidence.summary: fstab updated with tmpfs entries for /tmp and /dev/shm using nosuid,nodev,noexec; findmnt confirms options applied; exec attempts on both paths returned Permission denied (rc=126)

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline of the specific hardening (immediately before reboot)
evidence.summary: Confirmed boot_id dfdea52d..., /tmp and /dev/shm mount options, and fstab entries right before initiating restart
Backgrounded shutdown -r now command; exec call returned success acknowledging dispatch before the node went down

evidence.requirement: Node down / connection dropped due to restart
evidence.summary: Connection reset by peer confirms node was mid-restart

evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proving an actual restart occurred
evidence.summary: New boot_id 573fdad6-9552-4bdc-ab02-5f6be39b23a5 differs from pre-restart dfdea52d..., proving the kernel actually restarted

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required mount hardening, functionally verified
evidence.summary: After restart, /tmp and /dev/shm both show nosuid,nodev,noexec (mounted automatically from fstab), exec attempts denied (rc=126 both), and fstab entries intact

attempts.summary: Configured /tmp (new tmpfs mount) and /dev/shm on node1 with noexec,nosuid,nodev via persistent /etc/fstab entries, verified functionally (exec attempts denied) both before and after a full node restart, and confirmed persistence via a changed boot_id.
